圆融地；以外交方式（diplomatic 加 -ly，语义由性质转为方式）
不圆融的；直来直去的（un- 加 diplomatic，语义加否定，指缺少分寸）
外交家；外交事务专家（diplomatic 加 -ist，旧式说法，语义由性质转为人与职业）
文凭；公文（希腊 diploma「对折的纸」，语义由折叠文书转到证书，与外交实务分道）

senses.title: The conduct of relations between states
senses.titleCN: 处理国家间关系的实务
senses.definition: the ongoing work of managing contact between governments through talks, representation and agreement rather than force
senses.definitionCN: 通过会谈、派驻代表与达成协议而非武力来处理政府之间往来的持续工作
senses.example: Quiet diplomacy kept the two delegations talking through the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 静默外交让两个代表团在整个冬天都保持对话。
senses.why: The word names the business that credentials and envoys exist to carry on, so it points to the activity rather than to any one paper.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是凭证与使节存在的目的所指向的那项业务，因此指活动而非某一份纸页。

senses.title: The profession and the diplomatic service
senses.titleCN: 外交这一职业与外交界
senses.definition: the career, ranks and institutions of officials who represent a state abroad
senses.definitionCN: 在海外代表国家的官员所从事的职业、等级与机构
senses.example: She entered diplomacy after ten years in the foreign ministry.
senses.exampleCN: 她在外交部工作十年后进入了外交界。
senses.why: Once the activity is organized into a service with ranks, the name of the activity also names the career.
senses.whyCN: 当这项活动被组织成有等级的部门后，活动的名称也指这份职业。

senses.title: Skill in negotiation
senses.definition: the ability to trade concessions, time moves and read the other side in order to reach an agreement
senses.definitionCN: 通过交换让步、掌握时机与判断对方来达成协议的能力
senses.example: The deal was saved by patient diplomacy behind closed doors.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔交易靠闭门之后的耐心谈判手腕才得以挽回。
senses.why: The activity demands a craft, and the abstract noun soon named the craft itself rather than the institution.
senses.whyCN: 这项活动需要技艺，这个抽象名词很快便指技艺本身，而非机构。

senses.title: Tact in ordinary dealings
senses.titleCN: 日常处事中的圆融得体
senses.definition: the everyday skill of handling people and conflicts without giving offence
senses.definitionCN: 在日常中处理人际关系与冲突而不冒犯他人的能力
senses.example: It took diplomacy to tell him his proposal had already been rejected.
senses.exampleCN: 要告诉他提案早已被否决，是需要一点圆融的。
senses.why: Negotiators became the model of tact, so the noun moved from the conference room to the kitchen table.
senses.whyCN: 谈判者成了分寸的样板，于是这个名词从会议室走到了饭桌。

senses.title: Work in an embassy abroad
senses.definition: the daily duties of a mission, from visa interviews to reporting on the host country
senses.definitionCN: 驻外机构的日常职责，从签证面谈到对驻在国的情势汇报
senses.example: His first year of diplomacy was spent processing visa files.
senses.exampleCN: 他外交生涯的第一年都在处理签证档案。
senses.why: The grand word covers the paperwork of a mission, and that is where most of the work actually happens.
senses.whyCN: 这个宏大的词也涵盖驻外机构的文书工作，而大部分实际工作正发生在这里。

senses.title: Shuttle and multilateral diplomacy
senses.definition: named modes of the craft, such as a mediator travelling between capitals or many states bargaining in one forum
senses.definitionCN: 指这门技艺的特定模式，如斡旋者往返各首都，或许多国家在同一场合谈判
senses.example: Shuttle diplomacy produced a ceasefire after three weeks of flights.
senses.exampleCN: 经过三周的飞行往返，穿梭外交促成了停火。
senses.why: Modern practice developed repeatable formats, and the noun attaches to each format as a named method.
senses.whyCN: 现代实践发展出可重复的形式，这个名词便附着于每一种有名称的方法。

senses.title: Diplomacy as an instrument of policy
senses.definition: the use of envoys, aid, culture and sanctions as a softer alternative to military pressure
senses.definitionCN: 把使节、援助、文化与制裁当作军事压力之外的较软替代手段来使用
senses.example: The budget treated diplomacy as a cheaper defence than another brigade.
senses.exampleCN: 该预算把外交视为比再添一个旅更便宜的防务。
senses.why: Governments began to count influence as a resource, so the noun turned into a tool listed beside armies.
senses.whyCN: 各国政府开始把影响力当作一种资源来计算，这个名词于是变成与军队并列的工具。

senses.title: A figurative strategy of relations
senses.titleCN: 比喻：任何团体中的交际策略
senses.definition: a loosened use for the handling of alliances, rivals and feelings inside a company, family or club
senses.definitionCN: 较松散的用法，指在公司、家庭或俱乐部内部处理盟友、对手与情绪的方式
senses.example: Office diplomacy decided who would sit near the new director.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室里的交际策略决定了谁会坐在新主管旁边。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the shape of many parties, limited goods and face-saving, which any group reproduces.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了多方、有限资源与顾全面子的结构，而任何团体都会重现这一结构。

intro.en: Diplomacy reaches English through French diplomatie, a noun built on diplomatique, which goes back to Latin diploma and Greek diploma, 'a paper folded in two'. It is not a direct 'diploma plus -cy' coinage. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: diplomacy 经法语 diplomatie 进入英语；diplomatie 是在 diplomatique 基础上构成的名词，而 diplomatique 可追到拉丁 diploma 与希腊 diploma「对折的纸」。它并非「diploma 加 -cy」的直接构词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Diploun 'to fold' comes from diploos 'twofold', giving the physical image of a sheet folded once.
items.cn: diploun「折」源自 diploos「双重的」，给出了一张纸对折一次的物理意象。

items.en: The noun named a folded paper and later the letter an envoy carried to prove his commission.
items.cn: 这个名词指对折的纸，后来指使节随身携带、用以证明委任的信函。

items.en: Latin used diploma for official documents and travel warrants, the paper that opened doors for an envoy.
items.cn: 拉丁用 diploma 指官方文书与旅行许可，正是这份纸为使者打开了门。

items.en: French coined diplomatie in the eighteenth century from diplomatique, naming the business that envoys carried on.
items.cn: 法语在十八世纪由 diplomatique 造出 diplomatie，命名使节所从事的那项业务。

items.en: English borrowed the French noun for the conduct of state relations and later extended it to tact in any setting.
items.cn: 英语借入这个法语名词，指处理国家关系的行为，后又扩展到任何场合中的分寸。

items.en: Source uncertain (dates and details): the first English use is dated only approximately, and the precise path by which the credential sense became the craft sense is not fully documented.
items.cn: 来源不确定（年代与细节）：英语首见年代只有约数；从「凭证」义转为「技艺」义的确切路径也缺乏完整书证。

note.en: Group one holds same-root words that look alike and name different pieces of the same field; group two holds near synonyms that differ in whether they mean an activity, a method or a personal quality.
note.cn: 第一组是同根、外形相近却指同一领域不同部分的词；第二组是近义词，区别在于指活动、方法还是个人品质。

entries.definition: An official who practises the craft; the noun names a person, while diplomacy names the activity.
entries.definitionCN: 指从事这门技艺的官员；这个词命名人，而 diplomacy 命名活动。

entries.definition: The adjective of the field and of tact; it describes, while diplomacy names.
entries.definitionCN: 是该领域与分寸的形容词；它作描述，而 diplomacy 作命名。

entries.definition: The folded document or a certificate of study; it is a thing, not a practice.
entries.definitionCN: 指对折的文书或学业证书；它是一件东西，不是一种实践。

entries.definition: The scholarly analysis of old official documents, a separate discipline with its own methods.
entries.definitionCN: 指对古代官方文书的学术分析，是一门有自身方法的独立学科。

entries.definition: The whole art of managing a state, including domestic policy; diplomacy is its external branch.
entries.definitionCN: 指治理国家的整体技艺，包括内政；diplomacy 是其对外分支。

entries.definition: The specific process of bargaining toward a deal; diplomacy may include negotiation but also representation and ceremony.
entries.definitionCN: 指为达成交易而讨价还价的特定过程；diplomacy 可含谈判，但也含派驻与礼仪。

entries.definition: The personal knack of not giving offence; it is one ingredient of diplomacy, not the whole craft.
entries.definitionCN: 指不冒犯他人的个人本领；它是外交的一项成分，而非全部技艺。

entries.definition: A government's stated goals abroad; diplomacy is one of the means used to pursue them.
entries.definitionCN: 指一国政府对外宣称的目标；diplomacy 是实现这些目标的手段之一。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root image is a paper folded once: the credential that let an envoy speak, and the trade that grew around it.
normal.cn: 词根意象是一张对折的纸：它让使节得以开口，围绕它长出了一门行业。

normal.en: The family runs diploma, diplomat, diplomacy, diplomatic, diplomatically, undiplomatic.
normal.cn: 同族词依次是 diploma、diplomat、diplomacy、diplomatic、diplomatically、undiplomatic。

normal.en: Fixed collocations mark the modes: quiet diplomacy, shuttle diplomacy, public diplomacy, multilateral diplomacy.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各种模式：静默外交、穿梭外交、公共外交、多边外交。

normal.en: The abstract noun covers both the institution and the skill, which is why it can mean a ministry's work and a dinner-table grace.
normal.cn: 这个抽象名词同时涵盖机构与技艺，因此既能指一个部的工作，也能指饭桌上的得体。

normal.en: Near words split by role: statecraft governs, negotiation bargains, tact soothes, foreign policy aims.
normal.cn: 近义词按角色分工：statecraft 治理，negotiation 讨价，tact 安抚，foreign policy 设定目标。

abstract.en: Picture two chairs facing each other across a table, neither pushed back.
abstract.cn: 想象两把椅子隔着桌子相对，两把都没有被推开。

abstract.en: Picture one folded note passed from hand to hand until the crease wears soft.
abstract.cn: 想象同一张对折的便笺在几双手之间传递，折痕被磨得发软。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge laid plank by plank, each plank one more round of talks.
abstract.cn: 想象一座桥一块板一块板地铺成，每块板就是又一轮会谈。

examples.en: Years of patient diplomacy finally produced a border agreement.
examples.cn: 多年的耐心外交终于促成了一份边界协议。

examples.en: Sanctions without diplomacy rarely change a government's mind.
examples.cn: 没有外交配合的制裁很少能改变一个政府的想法。

examples.en: She handled the family quarrel with the diplomacy of a seasoned envoy.
examples.cn: 她以老练使节般的外交手腕处理了这场家庭争吵。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「diplo（对折）+ macy（办事）」——纸能对折，话能转弯 → 外交；手腕

root: 希腊 diploma「对折的纸」源自 diploun「折」，经拉丁 diploma「公文、通行凭证」进入法语 diplomatique；法语再以 diplomatique 构成名词 diplomatie，英语借入为 diplomacy。它并非「diploma 加 -cy」的直接构词；圆融义为后起引申。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one craft: a folded credential lets an envoy speak, and that speaking becomes a daily practice, a career, a negotiating skill, a household tact, an embassy routine, named modes, a policy tool, and finally any group's private strategy.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一门技艺展开：一份对折的凭证让使节得以开口，这种开口再成为日常实务、一种职业、谈判技艺、家庭中的分寸、使馆例行工作、有名称的模式、政策工具，最后是任何团体内部的交际策略。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two parties kept at one table by talk alone, with a folded credential lying between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两方仅靠谈话被留在同一张桌边，中间放着一份对折的凭证。

branches.en: ACTIVITY AND CAREER: the daily conduct of relations and the service that carries it out are one practice seen as work and as profession (S1, S2).
branches.cn: 实务与职业：日常的关系处理与执行它的部门，是同一实践作为工作与作为职业的两面（义项一、二）。

branches.en: SKILL AT TWO TABLES: bargaining across a treaty and sparing a colleague's feelings use the same craft at different stakes (S3, S4).
branches.cn: 两种桌上的技艺：隔着条约讨价与顾全同事的感受，是同一种本事在不同赌注下（义项三、四）。

branches.en: POST AND METHOD: visa files in an embassy and a mediator flying between capitals are the routine and the named modes of one service (S5, S6).
branches.cn: 驻馆与方法：使馆里的签证档案与往返各首都的斡旋者，是同一项工作的日常与有名称的模式（义项五、六）。

branches.en: INSTRUMENT: once counted against brigades, the craft becomes a line in a defence budget (S7).
branches.cn: 工具：一旦与旅级部队相提并论，这门技艺就成了防务预算里的一行（义项七）。

branches.en: METAPHOR: any office or family repeats the table, the limited goods and the face-saving in miniature (S8).
branches.cn: 比喻：任何办公室或家庭都以缩小的规模重演这张桌子、有限资源与顾全面子（义项八）。

intro.en: Diplomacy is a French abstract noun sitting on an adjective that sits on a Greek noun of folded paper; the endings, not a '-cy' added to 'diploma', carry the abstraction.
intro.cn: diplomacy 是法语抽象名词，其下是形容词，再下是希腊「对折纸」名词；抽象义由词尾承担，而非在 diploma 后加 -cy。

latinIntro.en: Greek diploma gives the noun, Latin diplomaticus the adjective, and French -ie turns that adjective into the name of the craft.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 diploma 提供名词，拉丁 diplomaticus 提供形容词，法语 -ie 再把这个形容词变成技艺的名称。

items.example: The physical act of folding is the oldest layer of the word.
items.exampleCN: 折叠这一物理动作是这个词最古老的一层。

items.structure: diploma, diplomatis (Greek noun, later Latin noun)
items.meaning: a folded paper; an official document
items.example: The credential is a folded sheet before it is a profession.
items.exampleCN: 在成为一门职业之前，这份凭证先是一张对折的纸。

items.example: The suffix turns the document into an adjective of its field.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把文书变成该领域的形容词。

items.meaning: relating to envoys and state papers
items.meaningCN: 与使节和国家文书相关的
items.example: The adjective is the bridge between paper and practice.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词是纸页与实践之间的桥。

items.example: French gave the Latin adjective its modern shape.
items.exampleCN: 法语赋予这个拉丁形容词现代形态。

items.example: The suffix turns the adjective into the name of a business.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把形容词变成一项业务的名称。

items.example: French coined the noun before English borrowed it.
items.exampleCN: 法语先造出这个名词，英语随后借入。

items.example: English kept the French ending almost unchanged.
items.exampleCN: 英语几乎原样保留了法语词尾。

items.example: The person noun was cut back from the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个指人的名词由形容词逆构而来。

latinEntries.meaning: an official document, a letter of recommendation

latinEntries.structure: diplomaticus, diplomatica, diplomaticum (adj., first and second declension)

definition_zh: 外交的；有外交手腕的；圆滑得体的
definition_en: relating to relations between countries, or skilled at handling people without giving offence
core_image: 两位代表分坐长桌两端，笑着握手，桌上各摆一面小旗
scene: 会谈结束后，双方代表在门口交换了几句客气话。Her diplomatic reply avoided a quarrel.
sceneCN: 这里 diplomatic 指「圆滑得体的」（第 2 个义项：不伤人地处理关系）；句意是她得体的回答避免了一场争吵。

pos.zh: 外交的；有外交手腕的；圆滑得体的

senses.title: Between countries
senses.definition: relating to the official relations of one country with another
senses.definitionCN: 与国与国之间的正式关系有关
senses.example: The two countries restored diplomatic relations.
senses.exampleCN: 两国恢复了外交关系。
senses.why: A border is a hard line, so words must do the work of bridges.
senses.whyCN: 边界是硬的线，只能让话语去当桥。

senses.title: Careful with people
senses.definition: saying a hard thing in a way that does not wound
senses.definitionCN: 把难听的话说得不伤人
senses.example: She gave a diplomatic answer and changed the subject.
senses.exampleCN: 她回答得很得体，随后换了话题。
senses.why: The same skill that keeps nations talking keeps a dinner pleasant.
senses.whyCN: 让两国继续说话的本事，也能让一顿饭不翻脸。

intro.en: Diplomatic comes from Latin diploma, a folded official letter, and Greek diploma, something folded in two.
intro.cn: diplomatic 来自拉丁语 diploma（对折的公文），更早可追到希腊语 diploma（折成两半的东西）。

items.en: Diploma meant a paper folded in two.
items.cn: diploma 指对折起来的纸。

items.en: Such folded papers carried letters of recommendation.
items.cn: 这种对折的纸常用来携带推荐文书。

items.en: Diploma named an official document of the state.
items.cn: diploma 指国家颁发的正式文书。

items.en: Diplomatique described the study of old official papers.
items.cn: diplomatique 指对古代公文的研究。

items.en: The word shifted from papers to the people who carry them.
items.cn: 这个词从文书转指拿着文书奔走的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the diplo- stem, while the meaning group names tactful and courteous behaviour.
note.cn: 形近组共用 diplo 词干，近义组则指圆融与有礼的举止。

entries.definition: an official who represents a country abroad
entries.definitionCN: 驻外代表本国的官员

entries.definition: the work of managing relations between countries
entries.definitionCN: 处理国与国关系的工作

entries.definition: a certificate given on finishing a course
entries.definitionCN: 完成学业后颁发的证书

entries.definition: careful not to hurt or annoy people
entries.definitionCN: 小心不伤人、不惹人的

entries.definition: showing good judgment in dealing with people
entries.definitionCN: 在处理人事上显得明智的

entries.definition: polite in a formal and considerate way
entries.definitionCN: 正式而体贴地有礼的

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a paper folded in two and end with a hard answer that leaves no bruise.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一张对折的纸开始，最后落到一句不留淤青的硬话。

normal.en: Diploma, diplomat, diplomatic: paper, person, manner.
normal.cn: diploma 是纸，diplomat 是人，diplomatic 是方式。

normal.en: A folded letter travels far because it can be opened politely.
normal.cn: 对折的信能走很远，因为它可以被客气地打开。

normal.en: Diplomatic words are soft on the outside and firm inside.
normal.cn: diplomatic 的话，外面软，里面硬。

normal.en: You can be diplomatic without telling a lie.
normal.cn: 得体并不等于说谎。

normal.en: The same adjective serves treaties and dinner tables.
normal.cn: 同一个形容词，既服务条约，也服务饭桌。

abstract.en: Picture two flags on one long polished table.
abstract.cn: 想象一张光洁长桌上摆着两面小旗。

abstract.en: Picture a letter folded so that the seal sits outside.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信折得让火漆露在外面。

abstract.en: Picture a smile that closes a difficult sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象一个微笑，把一句难说的话收住了。

examples.en: The crisis was settled by diplomatic means.
examples.cn: 这场危机通过外交手段解决。

examples.en: It was diplomatic of you to say nothing.
examples.cn: 你什么也没说，这很得体。

examples.en: She has a diplomatic way of refusing.
examples.cn: 她拒绝人的方式很圆融。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diplomatic 记成「地铺路马特」：地铺成路，马也走得稳，说话办事都讲分寸。

root: 来自拉丁语 diploma，指对折的公文，更早是希腊语 diploma（折成两半之物）。古代这种折纸用于携带推荐与通行文书，后来专指国家间的正式文件，再转指处理这些文件的官员与方式，于是有了「外交的」与「圆融得体的」两层意思。

sensesIntro.en: From an official paper folded in two, to the craft of keeping nations talking, to the small skill of not wounding a friend.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一张对折的公文，到让两国继续对话的手艺，再到不伤朋友的小本事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two flags facing each other across one polished table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张光洁长桌，两端各立一面小旗。

chain: A HARD THING IS SAID SOFTLY

branches.en: The first sense belongs to states and their papers.
branches.cn: 第一个义项属于国家与它们的文书。

branches.en: The second sense belongs to anyone at any table.
branches.cn: 第二个义项属于任何桌上的任何人。

branches.en: Both are about keeping a relationship alive through speech.
branches.cn: 两者都是靠说话让一段关系活下去。

branches.en: Tact is diplomacy shrunk to the size of a family.
branches.cn: 圆融，就是缩小到家庭尺寸的外交。

branches.en: The same courtesy works on treaties and on neighbours.
branches.cn: 同一份客气，对条约有用，对邻居也有用。

intro.en: Diplomatic gathers the diplo- family of papers, officials and manners.
intro.cn: diplomatic 聚起 diplo 一族词，围绕文书、官员与举止。

latinIntro.en: The base is Greek diploma, a thing folded in two, taken into Latin as an official document.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是希腊语 diploma（对折之物），进入拉丁语后指正式文书。

items.exampleCN: 他们选了一条外交途径。
这位外交官会说三种语言。
低调的外交结束了争端。
他委婉地避开了这个问题。
她把毕业证书装进框里。

items.meaning: not careful with other people's feelings
items.example: His undiplomatic remark ended the meal.
items.exampleCN: 他那句不得体的话结束了饭局。

items.meaning: the study of old official documents
items.exampleCN: 文书学有助于给旧契据断代。

items.meaning: a holder of a specialist certificate
items.example: The clinic lists every diplomate by name.
items.exampleCN: 诊所把每位持证专家的名字都列出来。

definition_zh: 直接的；直率的；指导；导演；指向
definition_en: going straight without anything in between, or to manage and guide something
core_image: 一支笔直的箭头穿过所有弯路，从一个点直指另一个点
scene: 他在纸上画了一条直线，把两个点连起来，中间不绕。She asked a direct question and waited for an answer.
sceneCN: 这里 direct 指「直接的」（第 1 个义项：不绕弯）；句意是她问了一个直接的问题，然后等着回答。

senses.title: Without a turn
senses.definition: going from one point to another with nothing in between
senses.definitionCN: 从一点到另一点，中间不夹别的东西
senses.example: There is a direct train to the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 有一趟直达机场的火车。
senses.why: The shortest line is also the one with no story to tell.
senses.whyCN: 最短的那条线，也是没有故事可讲的那条。

senses.title: Saying it plainly
senses.definition: saying what one means without softening it
senses.definitionCN: 把意思说出来，不做软处理
senses.example: He gave a direct answer, yes or no.
senses.exampleCN: 他给了直接的回答，行或不行。
senses.why: The words take the same straight path the arrow does.
senses.whyCN: 话也走那条直线，和箭头一样。

senses.title: To steer a group or a film
senses.definition: to tell people where to go or how to act
senses.definitionCN: 告诉人往哪儿走、该怎么演
senses.example: She directed the play for a small theatre.
senses.exampleCN: 她为一家小剧场导演了这出戏。
senses.why: Someone must hold the line so that others can follow it.
senses.whyCN: 总得有人按住那条线，别人才好跟着走。

intro.en: Direct comes from Latin dirigere, to set straight, from dis- and regere, to rule or guide.
intro.cn: direct 来自拉丁语 dirigere（弄直），由 dis- 与 regere（引导、统治）构成。

items.en: Regere meant to guide a line or to rule people.
items.cn: regere 指把线拉直，也指治理人。

items.en: Dirigere meant to set something in a straight line.
items.cn: dirigere 指把东西摆成直线。

items.en: The participle directus described a straight path.
items.cn: 分词 directus 形容笔直的路。

items.en: English direct meant straight, and soon also to guide.
items.cn: 英语 direct 先指笔直，很快也指引导。

items.en: Film gave the verb its sense of steering a production.
items.cn: 电影让这个动词多出「执导一部作品」的意思。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the rect- stem, while the meaning group covers straightness and guiding.
note.cn: 形近组共用 rect 词干，近义组则覆盖笔直与引导。

entries.definition: a person who manages or directs
entries.definitionCN: 负责管理或执导的人

entries.definition: an official instruction telling people what to do
entries.definitionCN: 指示人们如何做的正式指令

entries.definition: a list of names, addresses or files
entries.definitionCN: 姓名、地址或文件的列表

entries.definition: going forward without bending
entries.definitionCN: 不弯地朝前走的

entries.definition: to show someone the way
entries.definitionCN: 给某人指路

entries.definition: to lead or manage an activity
entries.definitionCN: 领导或管理一项活动

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with an arrow crossing a page and end with a director holding a whole play in line.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一支穿过纸面的箭头开始，最后落到把整出戏按在一条线上的导演。

normal.en: Regere is to rule a line: direct is to keep it straight.
normal.cn: regere 是把线拉直：direct 就是让它别弯。

normal.en: A direct flight has no city in the middle.
normal.cn: 直达航班中间没有别的城市。

normal.en: A direct answer saves everyone an hour.
normal.cn: 一个直接的回答，替所有人省下一小时。

normal.en: To direct people is to point, not to push.
normal.cn: direct 人是指方向，不是推人。

normal.en: Indirect is the same line with one bend added.
normal.cn: indirect 就是同一条线多拐了一个弯。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow drawn with a ruler across a map.
abstract.cn: 想象用尺子在地图上画出一道箭头。

abstract.en: Picture a signpost with one arm pointing home.
abstract.cn: 想象一块路牌，只有一只手指向家。

abstract.en: Picture a stage where every actor faces the same point.
abstract.cn: 想象舞台上所有演员都朝向同一点。

examples.en: The direct cause of the fire was a loose wire.
examples.cn: 这场火灾的直接原因是一根松动的电线。

examples.en: He directs a small company in the north.
examples.cn: 他在北方经营一家小公司。

examples.en: Please direct your questions to the manager.
examples.cn: 请把问题交给经理。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 direct 记成「地雷刻特」：地上刻一条直线，绕过雷，直着走。

root: 来自拉丁语 dirigere，由 dis-（分开）与 regere（引导、弄直）构成，本义是把东西摆成直线。由「笔直」引申出「直接的」「直率的」，由「把线拉直」引申出「指引、管理」，近代又用于「导演」一部作品。

sensesIntro.en: From a line with no bend, to words with no padding, to a hand that keeps others on the line.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条不弯的线，到一句不加铺垫的话，再到一只把别人按在线上手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow crossing a page without one bend.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支穿过纸面的箭头，一次也不弯。

chain: A WHOLE WORK FOLLOWS ONE WILL

branches.en: The first sense is the straight path itself.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是那条笔直的路。

branches.en: The second sense puts the straight path into speech.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这条直线放进话里。

branches.en: The third sense turns the line into command.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这条线变成指令。

branches.en: A straight road and a plain answer share one adjective.
branches.cn: 直路与直话共用一个形容词。

branches.en: Telling the truth and telling people where to go both need a firm line.
branches.cn: 说实话与指方向，都需要一条稳的线。

intro.en: Direct anchors the rect- family, all of it about straight lines and right guidance.
intro.cn: direct 撑起 rect 一族词，全都围绕直线与正确引导。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin regere, to guide straight, with the prefix dis- intensifying the setting.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 regere（拉直、引导），前缀 dis- 加强「摆正」的意味。

items.example: They took the most direct route.
items.exampleCN: 他们走了最直接的那条路。

items.meaning: the line in which something moves
items.example: The wind changed direction at noon.

items.meaning: in a straight or immediate way
items.example: She spoke directly to the crowd.

items.meaning: one who guides an organisation or a film
items.example: The director called a short meeting.
The new directive takes effect Monday.

items.meaning: a list that points to names or files
items.example: Look it up in the phone directory.
The route was indirect but lovely.
They rectified the error at once.

definition_zh: 方向；指示；指导；方面
definition_en: the line in which someone or something moves, points or develops
core_image: 一只指南针的针尖稳稳停住，四周刻着一圈细密的刻度
scene: 雾里看不清路，他低头看表盘上那根细针。The arrow points in the direction of the river.
sceneCN: 这里 direction 指「方向」（第 1 个义项：移动或指向的那条线）；句意是箭头指向河的方向。

senses.title: The line of movement
senses.definition: the line along which someone or something moves or points
senses.definitionCN: 人或物移动、指向所沿的那条线
senses.example: The bird flew in the direction of the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 那只鸟朝海的方向飞去。
senses.why: Every movement must choose one line and give up all the others.
senses.whyCN: 每一次移动都要挑一条线，同时放弃所有别的线。

senses.title: Instructions on how to do
senses.definition: words that tell someone how to reach a place or use a thing
senses.definitionCN: 告诉人怎么到某处或怎么用某物的那几句话
senses.example: Read the directions before you take the medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 吃药之前先看说明。
senses.why: A line on a map becomes a line of words.
senses.whyCN: 地图上的一条线，变成了一行字。

senses.title: The act of guiding
senses.definition: the control or leadership given to a piece of work
senses.definitionCN: 对一项工作给予的管理与带领
senses.example: The project grew under her direction.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目在她的指导下发展起来。
senses.why: The one who holds the line also decides where it will end.
senses.whyCN: 握住那条线的人，也决定它最后停在哪里。

intro.en: Direction comes from Latin directio, a setting straight, from dirigere, to guide.
intro.cn: direction 来自拉丁语 directio（摆正），词根是 dirigere（引导）。

items.en: Regere meant to keep a line straight or to rule.
items.cn: regere 指把线拉直，也指治理。

items.en: Dirigere meant to aim something along a line.
items.cn: dirigere 指让某物沿着一条线走。

items.en: Directio named the act of setting straight.
items.cn: directio 指摆正、对准这个动作。

items.en: English direction first meant the act of aiming.
items.cn: 英语 direction 最初指瞄准、对准的动作。

items.en: It widened to the line itself, to instructions and to leadership.
items.cn: 它扩展到那条线本身，也指说明与领导。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the direct- stem, while the meaning group names routes and bearings.
note.cn: 形近组共用 direct 词干，近义组则分别指路线与方位。

entries.definition: going straight without anything between
entries.definitionCN: 中间不夹东西、直着走的

entries.definition: in a straight or immediate way
entries.definitionCN: 以径直或立即的方式

entries.definition: a person who leads a company or a film
entries.definitionCN: 领导公司或执导影片的人

entries.definition: the path taken from one place to another
entries.definitionCN: 从一地到另一地所走的路

entries.definition: the angle that shows where something lies
entries.definitionCN: 显示某物所在方位的角度

entries.definition: the line along which something moves forward
entries.definitionCN: 某物向前移动所沿的线

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a compass needle and end with a project led by one steady hand.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一根指南针开始，最后落到由一只稳手带起来的项目。

normal.en: Direction is direct turned into a thing you can point at.
normal.cn: direction 是 direct 变成能用手去指的东西。

normal.en: Ask for directions means asking for words in place of a map.
normal.cn: 问路，是用一句话代替一张地图。

normal.en: A sense of direction lives in the body, not in the phone.
normal.cn: 方向感住在身体里，不在手机里。

normal.en: In all directions means the choice has not been made yet.
normal.cn: in all directions 是说还没做出选择。

normal.en: Under her direction means she holds the line for everyone.
normal.cn: under her direction 是说她替所有人握着那条线。

abstract.en: Picture a needle settling after a long swing.
abstract.cn: 想象一根指针摆了很久之后停住。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow painted on a road at a turn.
abstract.cn: 想象拐角路面上画着一个箭头。

abstract.en: Picture a row of walkers all leaning one way.
abstract.cn: 想象一排走路的人都往同一侧倾。

examples.en: The wind changed direction in the afternoon.
examples.cn: 下午风改了方向。

examples.en: The package came with clear directions.
examples.cn: 包裹里附了清楚的说明。

examples.en: The research moved in a new direction.
examples.cn: 这项研究转向了一个新方向。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 direction 记成「地雷克神」：地上的雷要绕开，得先看清哪边是方向。

root: 来自拉丁语 directio，由 dirigere（引导、弄直）而来，而 dirigere 又由 dis- 与 regere（拉直、统治）构成。本义是「摆正、对准」这个动作，后来指移动所沿的那条线，再引申为告诉人怎么走的说明，以及对工作的领导。

sensesIntro.en: From a needle choosing one line, to words that replace a map, to a hand that keeps a whole project on course.
sensesIntro.cn: 从指针选定一条线，到代替地图的几句话，再到把整个项目按在路上的那只手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a compass needle stopping on one line among many.
core.cn: 核心意象：指南针在许多条线里停住了一条。

branches.en: The first sense is the chosen line in space.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是空间里被选中的那条线。

branches.en: The second sense is the same line told in words.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把同一条线用话说出来。

branches.en: The third sense is the hand that keeps others on it.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把别人按在这条线上的那只手。

branches.en: A map and its instructions describe one path.
branches.cn: 地图与说明描述的是同一条路。

branches.en: Good instructions are leadership written down.
branches.cn: 好的说明，就是写下来的领导。

intro.en: Direction sits at the centre of the rect- family of straight lines and guidance.
intro.cn: direction 位于 rect 一族的中心，这一族围绕直线与引导。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin regere, to guide straight, reached through dirigere.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 regere（拉直、引导），经 dirigere 传下来。

items.example: The current runs in one direction.
He took the direct road home.
The path leads directly to the gate.
The directive was short and clear.

items.meaning: a list that points to things
items.exampleCN: 名录列出了每个办公室。
这个话筒的指向性很强。

items.example: An indirect route avoids the traffic.
items.exampleCN: 绕行的路线避开了拥堵。

definition_zh: 导演；主管；董事
definition_en: a person who controls how a film or play is made, or who leads a department or company
core_image: 片场中央一把折椅，椅背上印着名字，旁边的人都停下手等这个人发话
scene: 片场的灯全亮着，所有人放下手里的活，望向监视器后面那把椅子。The director asked for one more take.
sceneCN: 这里 director 指「导演」（第 1 个义项：影视或戏剧的总负责人）；句意是导演要求再拍一条。

senses.title: The one who shapes a film
senses.definition: a person who controls how a film, play or programme is made
senses.definitionCN: 掌管电影、戏剧或节目如何呈现的人
senses.example: The director cut the last scene from the film.
senses.exampleCN: 导演把最后一场戏从电影里剪掉了。
senses.why: Thirty people work, but one pair of eyes decides what stays.
senses.whyCN: 三十个人在干活，可留下什么只由一双眼睛决定。

senses.title: The head of a department
senses.definition: a senior person who manages a department or an institution
senses.definitionCN: 管理一个部门或机构的负责人
senses.example: She was promoted to director of the research centre.
senses.exampleCN: 她被提升为研究中心的主管。
senses.why: The door of an office carries a name, and that name answers for the room.
senses.whyCN: 办公室门上写着一个名字，这个名字就要为这间屋子负责。

senses.title: A seat on the board
senses.definition: one of the people chosen to guide the decisions of a company
senses.definitionCN: 被选来为公司决策把关的人
senses.example: The board of directors meets every Monday morning.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会每周一上午开会。
senses.why: The company needs a group of names that can be blamed or trusted together.
senses.whyCN: 公司需要一组名字，能被一起问责，也能被一起信任。

intro.en: Director comes from Latin dirigere, to set straight or guide, and first named any person who guided or governed.
intro.cn: director 来自拉丁语 dirigere（拉直、指引），最初泛指引路或管事的人。

items.en: Dirigere meant to set a line straight or to guide a course.
items.cn: dirigere 指把一条线拉直，也指引导方向。

items.en: Directus, its past participle, described something laid straight.
items.cn: 它的过去分词 directus 形容被拉直的东西。

items.en: Director named a guide, a person who set others on a course.
items.cn: director 指引路者，把别人带上某条路的人。

items.en: English took the word for a governor or a head of an office.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词，用来指管理者或机构首长。

items.en: The film industry gave it the everyday sense of the person behind the camera.
items.cn: 电影业又让它日常化，专指镜头背后的那个人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the direct- stem, while the meaning group names other people who lead a production or a team.
note.cn: 形近组共用 direct 这一段词干，近义组则列出其他带团队或带作品的人。

entries.definition: to guide a course or to aim something straight
entries.definitionCN: 指引方向或把某物对准

entries.definition: the line along which someone or something moves
entries.definitionCN: 人或物移动所沿的路线

entries.definition: an official instruction that tells people what to do
entries.definitionCN: 要求人们如何行事的正式指示

entries.definition: a person who makes films, especially one in charge of them
entries.definitionCN: 拍电影的人，尤指主导创作的人

entries.definition: a person who runs a team, a shop or a department
entries.definitionCN: 管理团队、店铺或部门的人

entries.definition: a person who watches over the work of others
entries.definitionCN: 监督他人工作的人

normalIntro.en: These hooks start at the chair with a name on it and end with the single word a whole set waits for.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一把印着名字的椅子开始，走到全组人都在等的那一句话。

normal.en: Direct plus -or is the one who gives the direction.
normal.cn: direct 加 -or，就是给方向的那个人。

normal.en: A film director says cut, and the scene stops.
normal.cn: 导演一喊停，整场戏就停住。

normal.en: A managing director runs the company, not the camera.
normal.cn: 总经理管公司，不管镜头。

normal.en: The board of directors sits above every department.
normal.cn: 董事会坐在所有部门之上。

normal.en: One name on the chair tells the whole crew who decides.
normal.cn: 椅子上印一个名字，全组就知道谁说了算。

abstract.en: Picture a folding chair with a name stencilled on the back.
abstract.cn: 想象一把折椅，椅背上印着名字。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised while thirty people freeze.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手抬起，三十个人同时定住。

abstract.en: Picture one word travelling from that chair to every corner of the set.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话从那把椅子传到片场每个角落。

examples.en: The director asked the actor to say the line again.
examples.cn: 导演让演员把那句台词再说一遍。

examples.en: He became the director of a small research institute.
examples.cn: 他成了一家小研究所的主管。

examples.en: Two directors resigned after the bad year.
examples.cn: 糟糕的一年过后，两名董事辞职了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 director 记成「带路的」：direct 是给方向，-or 是人，替全组指方向的人就是导演。

root: 来自拉丁语 dirigere（把线拉直、指引），过去分词 directus 意为被引直的。director 在拉丁语里指引路者，进入英语后先指管事的人，后来才专指电影与戏剧的导演，也指部门主管与公司董事。

sensesIntro.en: From the person who calls the shots on a set, to the head of a department, to a seat on the company board.
sensesIntro.cn: 从片场里发号施令的人，到部门的主管，再到公司董事会里的一个席位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chair with a name on it, and a whole crew waiting for one word.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把印着名字的椅子，一整组人都在等一句话。

branches.en: The first sense is the one who shapes a film or a play.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把电影或戏剧塑造成形的人。

branches.en: The second sense moves the same authority into an office.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把同一种权威搬进办公室。

branches.en: The third sense gives that authority a seat on a board.
branches.cn: 第三个义项给这种权威一个董事会的席位。

branches.en: Both senses share one act: choosing what the others will do.
branches.cn: 两个义项共有一个动作：决定别人该做什么。

branches.en: An office head and a board member both answer for a whole body.
branches.cn: 部门主管和董事都要为整个机构负责。

intro.en: Director gathers the direct- family, words about straight lines, guidance and command.
intro.cn: director 聚起 direct 一族词，围绕直线、指引与指挥。

latinIntro.en: Latin dirigere, to set straight, gives the stem direct-, seen in direct, direction and directive.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dirigere（拉直）给出词干 direct，见于 direct、direction 与 directive。

items.example: The director chose a young actress for the part.
items.exampleCN: 导演选了一位年轻女演员演这个角色。

items.example: She directed the traffic around the hole.
items.exampleCN: 她指挥车辆绕过那个坑。

items.meaning: the line along which something moves
items.example: The wind changed direction at dusk.
A new directive reached every office.
items.exampleCN: 一道新指令下达到了每个办公室。

items.meaning: in a straight line or with nothing between
items.example: The train goes directly to the airport.

items.meaning: not straight or not stated openly
items.exampleCN: 他给了一个间接的回答。

items.meaning: the group of directors of a company
to send or aim something wrongly
items.example: The sign misdirected half the visitors.
items.exampleCN: 那块牌子把一半游客指错了路。
